title: Introduce agent runner and request decoration boundary before main-agent parity
description: Rust ProcessStage currently converts events directly into provider requests. AstrBot's main agent layer owns persona, context decoration, quote/media enrichment, provider fallback, tool loop, and webchat-specific response policy. Rust should add a typed agent boundary before these concepts accumulate inside pipeline stages.

files.change: Define the typed boundary between pipeline process stage and provider/tool orchestration.
Separate persona, quote, multimodal, and context decoration from stage control flow.
Prepare a destination for LLM tool calls without coupling them to provider adapters.
Keep stage policy thin and delegate provider/tool orchestration through the agent boundary.

criteria: ProcessStage remains responsible for pipeline control, not agent orchestration internals.
ProviderRequest decoration is testable without running the whole pipeline.
Tool execution boundary from TASK-019 can plug into the agent runner later.
